doc: Return a 0/1 mask of length vocab: 1 where arange(vocab) equals the scalar id.
name: eq_range
reference:
def fn(ids, vocab):
    return (torch.arange(vocab, dtype=ids.dtype) == ids.reshape(-1)[0]).to(torch.float32)

doc: Select table rows by id via mask-and-sum over the vocab dimension.
name: masked_row_select

doc: Build a one-hot matrix from integer ids: out[i, ids[i]] = 1, else 0.
name: one_hot

doc: Fused: build a one-hot matrix (tokens x num_classes) from integer ids, then multiply by a constant table (num_classes x dim).
name: one_hot_gemm
reference:
def fn(ids, table):
    ids = ids.long().view(-1)
    onehot = torch.zeros(ids.shape[0], table.shape[0], dtype=table.dtype, device=table.device)
    onehot.scatter_(1, ids.view(-1, 1), 1.0)
    return onehot @ table
